newsitem.title: USA: Planes brush at New York's La Guardia Airport.
newsitem.headline: Planes brush at New York's La Guardia Airport.

text.p: A Delta Air Lines plane and a Continental Airlines plane clipped each other as they were taxiing to the runway in a thunderstorm at La Guardia Airport Friday evening, officials said.
Passengers were evacuated from the planes, but no serious injuries were reported in the accident, which happened at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Both aircraft suffered damage.
The right tail stabiliser of the Continental plane and the left wingtip of the Delta plane touched, a Port Authority spokeswoman said.
The Delta L-1011 plane, Flight 581, was bound for Atlanta. The Continental 737, Flight 479, was headed for Cleveland.
